Question 2

Find the equation of the upward-opening parabola that has its vertex at (3,−5) and which passes through the point (0,4).

a
(x−3)2=y+5
b
(x−3)2=−(y+5)
c
(x+5)2=y−3
d
(x−3)2=−2(y+5)
e
(x−3)2=2(y+5)
